pick.headline: Soviet special forces storm Amin's palace in Kabul
pick.summary: On 27 December 1979 Soviet KGB and military special forces stormed the Tajbeg palace in Kabul and killed Afghan leader Hafizullah Amin; Babrak Karmal was installed in his place.
pick.significance: The operation, disguised at first as an Afghan affair, was the opening act of the Soviet war in Afghanistan.

alternates.headline: Abu Nidal gunmen attack Rome and Vienna airports
alternates.summary: On 27 December 1985 gunmen of the Abu Nidal Organisation attacked El Al and TWA check-in counters at Rome and Vienna airports, killing nineteen people including five Americans.
alternates.significance: Washington blamed Libya for supporting the attackers, imposing sanctions in January and leading to the US bombing of Libya in April 1986.
